rooms.label: Section Office, Whitehall
rooms.description: A first-floor room in a building with no name on the door and no listing in any directory. Alderton sits behind a desk that has seen thirty years of crises, the surface invisible under files, a telephone, and a cold cup of tea. Rain against the sash windows. Outside: London, grey and indifferent.

examineTargets.label: Alderton
examineTargets.description: A lean man in his late fifties, a suit that might have fitted him in 1943, reading glasses he refuses to wear. He speaks quietly. 'The outpost is a relay station — or so they'd like us to think. The SOVA-7 arrived three weeks ago. We need photographs of the rotor configuration before they rotate the key. You have until dinner ends. The car will be waiting. Any questions?' He doesn't wait for any.

examineTargets.label: the mission file
examineTargets.description: A thin manila folder. Aerial photographs, a guard rotation, a map of the approach. You've memorised it. The file stays here.

examineTargets.label: the window
examineTargets.description: Whitehall in November. A bus. A man walking fast with his collar up. None of them know you exist. In forty-eight hours you'll be glad of that.

examineTargets.label: Evelyn
examineTargets.description: Alderton's secretary occupies the desk by the door — dark hair, a file open in front of her that she is very deliberately reading. She glances up. 'I know,' she says pleasantly, before you've said anything. She goes back to her file.

rooms.label: Mountain Road
rooms.description: A dirt track through pine trees. The outpost fence is visible ahead, lit by a single floodlight. Somewhere in the darkness, an engine ticks as it cools.

addenda.text: The car in the treeline flashes its lights once. Your ride is waiting.

examineTargets.label: the treeline
examineTargets.description: Pine trees, thick enough to hide a car. Or a man.

examineTargets.label: the black Volga
examineTargets.description: A black Volga, engine off, driver watching the fence.
examineTargets.interactLabel: Get in the Volga and leave

rooms.label: Perimeter Fence
rooms.description: Chain-link topped with barbed wire, ten feet high. A guardhouse sits to the east, light on inside. The fence runs out of sight in both directions.

addenda.text: A gap in the lower wire marks where you've been through.
A siren wails from inside the compound.

roll.failMessage: You clear the wire, but a sweep of the patrol torch catches you on the way down. The siren starts.

examineTargets.label: the perimeter fence
examineTargets.description: Chain-link, well-maintained. The lower section near the ditch looks weaker.

rooms.label: Service Yard
rooms.description: A concrete yard between the fence and the building. A bulkhead light flickers above the loading bay door. Supply crates are stacked along the near wall.

addenda.text: The yard is flooded with light. Someone has hit the exterior floods.

examineTargets.label: the supply crates
examineTargets.description: Wooden supply crates, stencilled in Cyrillic. Good cover, nothing useful.

examineTargets.label: the keycard reader
examineTargets.description: A heavy steel door with a keycard reader mounted beside it. Red light.

examineTargets.label: the bulkhead light
examineTargets.description: Flickering on a short cycle. Annoying, but it helps.

rooms.label: Loading Bay
rooms.description: Pallets, a forklift that hasn't moved in years, the smell of diesel. A door at the far end leads into the building proper.

addenda.text: Volkov is posted here, rifle unslung.
The bay is dark except for a single emergency indicator above the interior door.

examineTargets.label: the forklift
examineTargets.description: Soviet-era, rusted solid. Not going anywhere.

examineTargets.label: the pallets
examineTargets.description: Empty. Whatever was here has been moved inside.

examineTargets.label: the keycard reader
examineTargets.description: Same model as the exterior. The door is open from this side.

rooms.label: Ventilation Shaft
rooms.description: Tight crawl space, barely wide enough for your shoulders. The metal is cold. Air moves in both directions depending on which fan is running.

addenda.text: The ventilation fan kicks into high gear, air rushing past your face.

examineTargets.label: the shaft junction
examineTargets.description: A junction. Through the grille below you can hear voices — the comms room, directly beneath. Two men, radio static.

rooms.label: Ground Floor Corridor
rooms.description: Long, low-ceilinged. Strip lighting, linoleum floor, numbered doors. At the far end, Petrov stands with his back to the wall, rifle slung.

addenda.text: Red warning lights pulse along the ceiling. Somewhere a door slams.
The strip lighting is dead. Red emergency indicators pulse dimly at floor level.

exits.label: Ventilation grille (low, near the loading bay end)

examineTargets.label: the notice board
examineTargets.description: A patrol rota, handwritten. Volkov's name appears every six entries.

rooms.label: Mess Hall
rooms.description: Four tables, benches, the smell of boiled cabbage. The samovar in the corner is warm. The men are at dinner somewhere else — this room is empty.

addenda.text: Chairs pushed back, bowls half-eaten. Whoever was here left in a hurry.

exits.label: Storeroom door at the back of the hall

examineTargets.label: the samovar
examineTargets.description: Still warm. Dinner started recently. You don't have long.

examineTargets.label: the guard's jacket
examineTargets.description: A guard's jacket on a hook. Empty pockets, wrong size.

examineTargets.label: the table
examineTargets.description: Bowls of food, barely touched.

rooms.label: Comms Room
rooms.description: Banks of radio equipment lining three walls. Pvt. Nikitin sits at the main console with headphones on, back to the door, absorbed in traffic.

addenda.text: Nikitin is on his feet, shouting into a handset.
The radio banks are dead. Nikitin has pulled off his headphones and is reaching for a torch.

examineTargets.label: the radio equipment
examineTargets.description: Soviet military band. Encrypted traffic, layered and continuous.

examineTargets.label: the supply cabinet
examineTargets.description: A locked metal cabinet on the far wall.

rooms.label: Duty Officer's Office
rooms.description: Small and cluttered. A desk covered in papers, a framed photograph of a family — summer, a lake.

examineTargets.label: the desk
examineTargets.description: Papers, a coffee cup, an ashtray. Someone works long hours here.

examineTargets.label: the family photograph
examineTargets.description: A man in uniform, a woman, two children. A lake somewhere warm.

examineTargets.label: the desk drawer
examineTargets.description: A locked drawer. The lock looks standard.

examineTargets.label: the cipher room door
examineTargets.description: A steel door with a numeric keypad. Cipher room access only.

rooms.label: Cipher Room
rooms.description: Temperature-controlled, barely larger than a cupboard. The hum of electronics, cool recycled air. The SOVA-7 sits on a dedicated table under a desk lamp — rotors, key plugs, a Soviet star on the housing. No one is here.

addenda.text: The camera is back in your pocket. You have what you came for.
Muffled shouting from somewhere in the building. You need to move.

examineTargets.label: the SOVA-7
examineTargets.description: The SOVA-7. Heavier than it looks. The rotors are set for today's key. GCHQ will want every angle.

examineTargets.label: the wall clock
examineTargets.description: Quarter past eight. Dinner ends at nine. Probably.

examineTargets.label: the filing cabinet
examineTargets.description: Locked. Not worth the time.

rooms.label: Supply Storeroom
rooms.description: Narrow shelves from floor to ceiling — tinned provisions, cleaning supplies, a mop and bucket. The smell of carbolic soap. A wooden partition at the back conceals a door into the comms room.

addenda.text: The strip light has gone out. You navigate by feel along the shelves.

exits.label: Through the back door into the comms room

examineTargets.label: the shelves
examineTargets.description: Tinned borscht, cleaning powder, industrial soap. Nothing useful here.

examineTargets.label: the back door
examineTargets.description: Thin wood, a simple handle. Opens into the comms room. Nikitin won't hear it over the radio static.

rooms.label: Guard Barracks
rooms.description: Eight bunks, half made, half not. Three guards sleep at the far end — the night-shift men, off duty now. Personal effects on shelves above each bunk: photographs, a chess set mid-game, dog-eared paperbacks. The smell of boot polish and old cigarette smoke.

addenda.text: Empty bunks, rifles gone. Everyone has a post.
Dark. Through the wall you can hear someone cursing at the generator.

examineTargets.label: the bunks
examineTargets.description: Standard Soviet military kit. Clean, impersonal, lived-in.

examineTargets.label: the personal shelf
examineTargets.description: A photograph of a woman and children outside a dacha. A letter, half-written. A chess problem, unsolved.

examineTargets.label: the footlocker
examineTargets.description: Unlocked. Spare uniform, boot polish, a dented mess tin. One footlocker at the end is heavier than the rest.

rooms.label: Generator Room
rooms.description: Two diesel generators dominate the space, ticking over on low load. The heat is immediate. A smell of fuel and hot metal. Emergency lighting only — one bare bulb on a wire.

addenda.text: The generators are still, cooling in the dark. You did this.

examineTargets.label: the generators
examineTargets.description: Soviet military diesels. Well-maintained. A simple cutoff valve handles both.

examineTargets.label: the generator controls
examineTargets.description: A cutoff lever. Pull it and the compound loses power — lights out, cameras blind, but someone will come to check.

effect.text: You pull the lever. The generators cycle down with a deep groan. The lights die.

examineTargets.label: the fuel drums
examineTargets.description: Full. Standard diesel. Not useful unless you plan to burn the place down.

rooms.label: Guardhouse
rooms.description: A cramped duty booth. A thermal flask on the windowsill, a duty log open on the desk, the smell of cheap cigarettes. A door in the back wall leads directly into the service yard.

examineTargets.label: the duty log
examineTargets.description: Entries in a neat hand. Morozov has been at this post eighteen months. His handwriting gets worse toward the end of each shift.
